market_question: Will PSG win the 2025–26 Champions League?
reasoning: The market-implied probability of 58.5% for PSG to win the 2025–26 Champions League is extraordinarily high—no single team in modern Champions League history has had a preseason chance anywhere near that level. PSG lost Kylian Mbappé and, despite being a strong side, realistically holds around a 7% chance given the depth of top competitors like Real Madrid, Manchester City, and Bayern. This enormous gap signals a severe market overvaluation of the YES outcome.
evidence_points: Preseason betting odds for Champions League winners rarely imply above 15–20% for even the strongest teams; 58.5% is off the charts.
PSG are weaker after losing Mbappé and have a history of underperforming in UCL knockouts.
Other top clubs—Real Madrid (now with Mbappé), Man City, Bayern—are more plausible favorites, pushing PSG’s true odds into single digits.
